assumptions: Rates are what a client is billed, not what an agent is paid; they include facilities, technology, management and margin.
Domestic bands apply when the buyer sits in the same low-cost market as the delivery centre (an Indian bank served from India), because domestic BPO prices well below offshore export work.
Specialised work (clinical, licensed insurance or financial advice, level-2+ technical support, multilingual European language desks) carries a premium; non-voice back-office a small discount.
When only a target headcount is stated the engine assumes a ramp and uses 75% of the target as the average staffed level.
When the term is not stated the engine assumes 36 months and says so in the explanation.
